question: Related Questions Q. miscellaneous 2360 views Q. I had applied passport for my wife long back. I got transfer to Hyderabad and my family came with me.We contacted verification officer at police station that my wife won't be there during verification. He told me to submit all required documents and also demanded Rs 5000/- ,since they will take of my wife's absence during verification. I paid Rs 2500/- to the officer and verification was done successfully. Please let me know whether I can pay interest amount to pay this amount. 1646 views Q. Later I found that this money is not halaal for me. So I havent used that money and kept it aside. Please guide me as to what I should do with that money. I asked a local mufti and he said that I should return the money anyhow to the company. But I am not sure how can this be done. As I no longer work for the company, I am in a big dilemma with this money. Please guide me on this issue and what should be done with the money. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 10123 Country: AF Title: Asalamu alikum i am living in uae it is compulsury to make a health insurance card to renew visa or for a new visa the card is for one year which is used for discount treatment is the treatment by this card halal or not and. Question: Asalamu alikum i am living in uae it is compulsury to make a health insurance card to renew visa or for a new visa the card is for one year which is used for discount treatment is the treatment by this card halal or not and. Answer ID: 10123 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 109/103=B/1429) If visa is not obtained or renewed without having a health insurance card, then in case of exigency and need it will be allowable to get the card. As far as the matter of getting treatment facility is concerned, write down its details, then we can have a say in the matter. Does it not having interest and gambling? What are its advantages and disadvantages? Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
